title: Principal Ideal Local Test Criterion
statement: On a small ringed site with coefficient universe equal to its site universe, let I be the image ideal sheaf of multiplication by a compatible global section a. For any derived module object N, the covering-sieve principal local completeness condition is equivalent to IsLocallyDerivedRingedIdealComplete for I and its actual image inclusion. No regularity, boundedness or invertibility assumption is imposed on a or N. Dependencies: [def-weil-pbc-locally-derived-ringed-ideal-complete], [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system], [def-pur-ringed-principal-local-tests].

proof.text: The principal image ideal gives exactly the covering-sieve formulation of local completeness. An image section locally lifts along the epimorphism onto the image and therefore is locally a scalar multiple. Conversely local scalar multiples locally lie in the image subsheaf, and the sheaf property of this subobject descends them to an image section. A compatible slice section is determined by its terminal value; substitute this value in both formulations. Their localization and exact derived-restriction tests then agree. This includes the zero and unit ideals. Source: Stacks 0999, 099B and 03DA.

    (a : (O.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections) (N : DerivedCategory A) :

      ((sheafCompose (J.over U) (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj (O.over U))) :=
        principalLocalTestSliceDerived O
    principalLocallyComplete.{u, u, u, w} O a N ↔
      IsLocallyDerivedRingedIdealComplete.{u, w} O (image (ringedKoszulScalar O a))
        (image.ι (ringedKoszulScalar O a)) N
